profit_quality.assessment: 2025 reported profit is not a clean recurring cash profit base. Major contributors include HK$174.6m share of JV profits, HK$64.3m interest income, HK$50.3m investment property valuation gain and HK$17.5m FVPL gains. Because deposits and listed investments are deducted as detachable assets, their interest, dividends and fair-value gains are excluded from the profit denominator. The main pre-haircut denominator uses 2025 operating profit before working-capital changes of HK$48.423m less three-year median PPE capex of HK$6.083m, then applies a 0.55 cash-profit haircut for property-cycle/project volatility and weak three-year operating cash conversion.
adjustments: Exclude bank/deposit interest income of HK$64.296m because related deposits are deducted from purchase price.
Exclude listed investment dividends of HK$6.957m and FVPL fair-value gains of HK$17.513m because listed financial assets are deducted from purchase price.
Exclude investment property valuation gains of HK$50.301m as non-cash fair-value gains.

Exclude share of JV profits of HK$174.616m from the recurring denominator; 2025 management discussion attributes profit uplift partly to a one-off construction cost adjustment in a development project.
Use HK$6.083m as maintenance PPE capex estimate, the 2023-2025 median of purchases of other PPE.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was -HK$282.1m in 2023, HK$5.0m in 2024 and HK$69.9m in 2025; the three-year aggregate operating cash flow to aggregate parent net profit ratio is about 15.1%.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 0.55 reflects recurring rental income support but weak multi-year cash conversion, loss-making ferry/medical segments, property-development working-capital swings, and exclusion of financial-asset returns after deducting their principal.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Poor on a three-year aggregate basis; 2025 improved but still much lower than accounting profit after removing non-cash and project/JV items.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; PPE purchase median is used. Investment property additions are excluded from maintenance capex but noted as capital allocation burden.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Property inventory moved sharply across 2023-2025, including transfer of The Symphonie from completed properties to investment properties; use haircut rather than best-year cash flow.

limitations: Market cap comes from rough-screen input and is not independently refreshed in this run.
Annual report does not disclose parent/subsidiary cash split; company-level cash is only HK$2.45m, while distributable reserves are held at company level and cash sits largely in subsidiaries.
No explicit restricted-cash line was found, but bank deposits over three months still receive a haircut and operating cash/friction reserves are deducted.
The group has property development, property investment, securities investment and JV property financing exposure; ordinary operating-company formula is usable only with conservative profit haircut.
2023 and 2024 reports were downloaded into this run's work directory only for three-year cash-flow support; only the 2025 fact pack is written to stock_report_paths.
